f.n: Marianas Trench Marine National Monument - Island Unit
f.pu: To allow for commercial fishing to occur in the marine national monument.
f.re: 1. Commercial fishing is prohibited. 2.Non-commercial fishing is prohibited in the Monument, except as authorized under permit and pursuant to federal procedures and criteria. Permits may not be transferred.
f.ma: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service; NOAA
